data:
Die Beziehung einer Mutter zu ihrer Tochter steht in diesem Dokumentarfilm im Vordergrund. Dabei wird das Leben der beiden Frauen in den türkischen Städten Izmir und Hatay/Antakya genauer betrachtet. Die Familie wird den kompletten Alltag über von Filmemacher Michael Hehl begleitet und dieser spürt den Fragen nach: Wie ist das Verhältnis der beiden zueinander? Welche Umstände beeinflussen die Beziehung von Mutter und Tochter? Es kommt immer wieder zu Konflikten zwischen den Frauen. Die junge, forsche Tochter hat teilweise komplett andere Ansichten zu bestimmten Themen als die doch recht traditionelle türkische Mutter. So sind Mutter und Tochter zwar nicht immer einer Meinung, doch haben die beiden auch mehr gemeinsam als sie denken. Dadurch, dass der Filmemacher auf Interviews verzichtet und nur die Dialoge zwischen den beiden mitschneidet, entsteht eine große Nähe zu den Protagonisten. (This documentary focuses on the relationship between a mother and her daughter. It takes a closer look at the lives of the two women in the Turkish cities of Izmir and Hatay/Antakya. Filmmaker Michael Hehl follows the family throughout their everyday lives and explores the following questions: What is their relationship like? What circumstances influence the relationship between mother and daughter? There are always conflicts between the women. The young, brash daughter sometimes has completely different views on certain topics than the rather traditional Turkish mother. Mother and daughter may not always agree, but they have more in common than they think. The fact that the filmmaker dispenses with interviews and only records the dialog between the two creates a great closeness to the protagonists.

This documentary focuses on the relationship between a mother and her daughter. It takes a closer look at the lives of the two women in the Turkish cities of Izmir and Hatay/Antakya. Filmmaker Michael Hehl follows the family throughout their everyday lives and explores the following questions: What is their relationship like? What circumstances influence the relationship between mother and daughter? There are always conflicts between the women. The young, brash daughter sometimes has completely different views on certain topics than the rather traditional Turkish mother. Mother and daughter may not always agree, but they have more in common than they think. The fact that the filmmaker dispenses with interviews and only records the dialog between the two creates a great closeness to the protagonists.
